title: Lawrence's stories of Bunk Johnson's temper
summary: Lawrence said he was the go-between with Bunk, who was irritable and thought poorly of his band members.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Didn't they call it to a melody?

No, not unconscious. No, not unconscious. Not unconscious. No, not unconscious. No, not unconscious. No, not unconscious. I'm sure. But, uh... Anyway. Well, Lawrence said that he was the only one that got along with Bunk, whether that's true or not, I don't know. Lawrence said that he was constantly acting as a go-between between Bunk and the rest of the guys in the band, and that Bunk was mostly irritable and hard to get along with, very temperamental, and felt that they were pretty poor musicians, even Baby. Yeah, I think he used to call Baby the iron foundry or something.
Didn't he care for Baby as musicians? That's what I understand.
